summary: Millicom International Cellular S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, announcing the acquisition of the remaining 32.5% equity stake in Colombia Telecomunicaciones S.A. E.S.P. (Coltel) formerly held by La Nación. This follows Millicom's tender offer for Telefónica’s controlling stake in February 2026, completing full consolidation of Coltel. The press release emphasizes enhanced scale, 5G deployment, and digital inclusion in Colombia. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or advisor names are disclosed. The transaction gains regulatory and strategic significance by unifying operations under Millicom (Tigo). Watch for integration milestones and competitive responses in the Colombian telecom market.
